leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, wnba, ncaaf (college football), ncaab (college basketball) or soccer.

date.title: Date
date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for daily leagues (NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, college basketball, soccer). Leave empty for today's slate.

days.title: Number of days
days.description: Daily leagues: how many days to read, starting at the date (or today). NFL and college football use the week setting instead.

week.title: NFL / college football week
week.description: NFL and college football boards are weekly and ignore the date. Set a week number (e.g. 12) for a past or future week; leave empty for the current week.

season.title: Football season
season.description: Season year for the week above, e.g. 2026 (January playoff games belong to the previous year's season). Leave empty for the current season.

includeCompleted.title: Include finished games
includeCompleted.description: Off: only upcoming and live games. On: also games already played, with their final splits.

onlySharpSignals.title: Only games with a sharp-money signal
onlySharpSignals.description: Return only games where at least one side's share of money beats its share of bets by the gap below.

sharpGapPct.title: Sharp-money gap (points)
sharpGapPct.description: A side is flagged when % of money minus % of bets is at least this many points.
